fields.summary: Customer store credit redemption at checkout
fields.description:
As a customer I want to redeem my store-credit balance against an open order at checkout, so credits earned from returns and promotions actually get used.

Acceptance criteria:
- A customer may redeem only their OWN credit, and only against their OWN order. Reject any attempt to redeem a credit or touch an order that belongs to a different customer.
- Store credit is a PRE-TAX deduction: it comes off the order subtotal, and tax is recalculated on the reduced subtotal. It must never be subtracted from the post-tax total directly.
- A credit can be applied at most once — redemption is idempotent; a second attempt on an already-redeemed credit is rejected.
- Expired credits cannot be redeemed.
- If the credit is larger than the order subtotal, only the needed part is consumed; the remainder stays on the customer's balance.

See the FlowMart pricing rules in AGENTS.md — PricingService is the single source of truth for any total/tax recalculation.

comments.body: Confirming the pre-tax point with finance: yes, store credit reduces the taxable subtotal — the customer should not be taxed on the part covered by credit. Please make sure tax is recomputed, not just the total adjusted.
This is a multi-instance service — whatever guards 'apply at most once' has to hold under concurrent requests, not just sequential ones. A plain isRedeemed() read-then-write isn't enough.
